aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, daughter of Bhagīratha,
moonlight to the cakora birds that are the hosts of sages,
worshipped by men, nāgas and gods;
victory to you, daughter of Jahnu.
aarti.pad1: You are born of the lotus feet of Viṣṇu,
you are Tripathagā, who flows by three paths (heaven, earth and the underworld), a store of merit,
aarti.pad2: you are cool and take away the three afflictions;
and garlands of waves that curl and curve.
aarti.pad3: With the townspeople's offerings of worship,
your stream shines, white as the moon;
you break the burden of worldly existence,
and are the basin round the wish-granting tree of devotion.
aarti.pad4: The birds that live on your banks,
the beasts and winged insects of water and land,
the worms and the ascetics with matted hair:
you nurture all of them alike.
aarti.pad5: Give Tulasīdāsa a mind that wanders along your banks, remembering the hero of the Raghu line;
you are Kālikā to the buffalo-demon of delusion.
